cleanup_sequence: review and authorize a separate gated apply
download and revalidate the exact active kernel package archives
remove only the exact rollback package records
reinstall the exact active package set to repair shared package paths
verify the active module tree and versioned boot artifacts
atomically remove the oldkernel stanza from elilo.conf
remove only now-unreferenced legacy rollback artifacts
capture final evidence and require reboot validation
failure_policy: Stop before the next boundary and preserve or restore the ELILO rollback configuration.
next_required_stage: Run and review the non-destructive retention preflight; do not implement cleanup apply until eligibility evidence is accepted.
